title: 16 June 1960: Live: The Institute, Neston, Wirral
content:
This was The Beatles’ third consecutive Thursday night show at the Neston Institute, a venue run by promoter Les Dodd.

The group played at the Institute six times in all, ending on 7 July 1960.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024
